title: Speed Faceoff
tagline: Compare runtime cost and success score across five real-world tasks.
yAxisLabel: Runtime cost (lower is better) / Score (higher is better)

curves.label: Sort: Merge (Stable)
curves.code: mergeSort(A){ if(A.length<=1)return A; L=mergeSort(A[:mid]); R=mergeSort(A[mid:]); return merge(L,R); }
curves.name: Sort: Merge (Stable)

curves.label: Sort: Quick (Unstable)
curves.code: quickSort(A){ if(A.length<=1) return A; p=partition(A); return quickSort(A[0:p])+[A[p]]+quickSort(A[p+1:]); }
curves.name: Sort: Quick (Unstable)

curves.label: Path: A* Euclid
curves.code: openSet.push(start); while(openSet){ cur=popLowest(openSet,f=g+h); if(cur==goal)break; for(nbr of neighbors){ tentG=g[cur]+cost; if(tentG<g[nbr]){ parent[nbr]=cur; g[nbr]=tentG; f[nbr]=g[nbr]+euclid(nbr,goal); } } }
curves.name: Path: A* Euclid

curves.label: Path: Dijkstra
curves.code: dist[start]=0; open=MinHeap(); open.push([0,start]); while(open){ [d,u]=open.pop(); if(u==goal)break; for(v of neighbors(u)){ nd=d+cost(u,v); if(nd<dist[v]){ dist[v]=nd; open.push([nd,v]); } } }
curves.name: Path: Dijkstra

curves.label: Encrypt: Naive RSA
curves.code: for(chunk in message){ c = modPow(chunk, e, n); output.push(c); }
curves.name: Encrypt: Naive RSA
